text:
Sam: Quick ask — can we run a cross‑SKU latency sweep for llama-2-13b-q4f16 @ 2048 ctx? Need p50/p80/p95/p99, mem & GPU util, and raw logs. Target SKUs: A100, H100, L40S. Batch sizes: 1,2,4. Please include a fallback kernel run too. Link to sheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/bench-results (tab: sku-night-sweep)
Anita: I can take H100 overnight. Which kernel tag + driver should I use? also want to confirm synthetic prompts vs real traces.
Sam: Use kernel tag opt-v3 (the one in releases/kernel-opt-v3). Driver: 535.86. Synthetic set = latency_small_2048 (we picked it to reduce variance). Also set --warmup=200 and samples=1200. Please add run metadata: kernel=opt-v3, fallback=false for primary.
Kevin M: I'll do A100. I'll run two variants: primary opt-v3 and fallback (fused=false). Command I'll run:
```bash
./run_bench --model=llama-2-13b-q4f16 --ctx=2048 --batch=1 --warmup=200 --samples=1200 --tag=opt-v3
```
Maya: I'll pick up L40S. Heads up L40S needs cudnn 9.2 and we've seen a p99 uplift on longctx in prior sweeps. I'll include `--collect=heatmap,kvloss` and set --batchpad=32. Also will capture nvidia-smi logs and nvlink counters.
perf-bot: scheduled bench job 3421: (A100) owner=Kevin M, benchset=latency_small_2048, samples=1200
Anita: Quick Q — do you want thermal/clock governors forced? last sweep had variable clocks causing noisy tails.
Sam: Yes, pin clocks to performance profile where possible (governor=perf). If pinned clocks not available, add note 'clock_unpinned'. Also abort if GPU temp > 82C.
Kevin M: Got it. I'll also capture nvlink and pci errors. Will upload logs to the sheet + s3://redwood-bench/sku-night-sweep/kevin-a100-208765
Maya: L40S run queued on bench-l40s-3. Will run primary+fallback. Note: fallback on L40S is actually faster for batch=4 in some microconfigs — will report both.
Anita: H100 run started on h100-2b, job id hb-2087. Running primary now.
Sam: Owners: Anita(H100), Kevin M(A100), Maya(L40S). Please paste quick summary line in thread when done (p50/p95/p99 + any anomalous warnings). Deadline: EOD PST tomorrow but earlier is great.
perf-bot: h100 run hb-2087 finished (primary). summary: p50=9.8ms, p95=24.5ms, p99=48.7ms. full logs: s3://redwood-bench/sku-night-sweep/anita-h100-208765.log
Anita: Uploading parsed CSV to sheet now. Observed a microburst at sample 482 — looks like scheduler preemption (adding notes). Will re-run fallback next.
Kevin M: A100 primary done. quick summary: p50=11.3ms, p95=26.1ms, p99=52.9ms. nvlink: steady. Logs at s3://redwood-bench/sku-night-sweep/kevin-a100-208765.log
Maya: L40S primary done: p50=8.9ms, p95=22.9ms, p99=50.1ms. fallback run shows p99=45.6ms (interesting). Uploading heatmaps + nvml traces.
Sam: This is great — initial impression: L40S p50/p95 look best, p99s are mixed. Anita please re-run H100 fallback and Kevin can run A100 fallback asap. After fallback runs, perf-bot: please generate a pairwise p99 diff table.
Anita: Starting fallback run now (hb-2087-fallback).
Kevin M: Starting A100 fallback run (a100-job-2087-fallback). Will include clock_unpinned tag for one variant to show noise.
Maya: Dropping a screenshot of heatmap to the sheet and a note about memory hot spots on layer 18.
perf-bot: queued transform: bench-3421 -> pairwise-diff task 77 (will post table when all three fallback runs complete)
Sam: Thanks all. If you hit noisy tails, add `--seed=42` and a note. Also ping eng-sre if any rack shows >82C. Will review table once perf-bot posts.
Anita: fallback run finished. summary: p50=10.2ms, p95=25.1ms, p99=46.9ms. Added logs and marked microburst explanation in notes.
Kevin M: fallback done for A100. summary: p50=11.0ms, p95=25.7ms, p99=50.2ms. Uploaded full logs and nvlink stats.
perf-bot: pairwise-diff task 77 complete: attached table to sheet (tab: diff-p99). Quick take: A100 vs H100 p99 delta +3.3ms, L40S vs H100 delta -1.8ms. Full CSV: s3://redwood-bench/sku-night-sweep/diff-77.csv
Sam: Awesome. I'll file a short follow-up issue for optimization ideas (kv-caching, kernel-tweaks). Thanks team — will schedule a quick sync if needed. :thumbsup:
